_doc: Ruth voice cast (docs/ruth/VOICE.md). Schema: tools/story/voice.py docstring; breaths: tools/story/voice_extras.py.

narrator.instruct: 一位温暖的女讲故事人，像妈妈在床边给四到十岁的孩子讲圣经故事，声音亲切、生动、自然，语速正常流畅，不拖沓。这一句：

ruth.instruct: 一位二十岁左右的年轻姑娘，温柔、善良、有点害羞但很勇敢，像真人在演儿童广播剧，自然不做作，有真实的呼吸，语速正常流畅。这一句：

boaz.instruct: 一位四十多岁的田主，声音浑厚温暖，爽朗慈爱，像一位亲切的大叔，像真人在演儿童广播剧，自然不做作，语速正常。这一句：

reapers.instruct: 一个在田里干活的人，从田那头大声回应主人，高高兴兴、很自然，像真人。

naomi.design: 女性，六十多岁的老奶奶。音调中低，嗓音柔和、略带沙哑和气声，带着岁月的疲惫，但温暖慈爱。普通话标准。
naomi.instruct: 像真人在给四到十岁的孩子演圣经故事广播剧，自然不做作，有真实的呼吸声，语速正常流畅，不拖沓。这一句：

naomi.design: Female, around seventy, an elderly grandmother. Low pitch, husky, breathy and slightly creaky voice with the softness of old age; tired, but warm and loving. Standard American English.
naomi.instruct: Like a real actor in a children's Bible radio play for ages 4 to 10: natural, not overacted, with real breaths, at a natural flowing pace, never dragging. This line:

ru_01.m: 讲故事的开头，轻柔亲切，语速自然；说到“都去世了”之前停一下，声音低一点、很温柔，但不阴沉
ru_01.m_en: storyteller opening; soft and slow; a real pause before 'had died', the voice drops and goes tender, never gloomy
ru_01.d: 画面：睡前，你翻开一本大图画书，孩子靠在你身边。
ru_01.d_en: Picture: bedtime, a big picture book open, the child leaning on you.

phrases.text: Long ago,
Naomi's husband and her two sons
died...
and only Ruth, her son's wife, stayed with her.

ru_02.m: 疲惫又慈爱，有点哽咽；开口前先轻轻叹一口气；最后那个“啊”很轻，几乎是在求她
ru_02.m_en: tired and loving, a little choked; a soft sigh before she starts; the last 'all right?' is gentle, almost begging
ru_02.d: 画面：你握着一个你很爱的人的手，却要劝她离开你。
ru_02.d_en: Picture: you hold the hand of someone you love and tell her to leave you.

ru_03.m: 发自内心，眼泪快掉下来但很坚定；“不，我不走”说得快而坚决，后面更温暖、更深情；“你的上帝”之前吸一口气
ru_03.m_en: from the heart, close to tears but steady; quick and firm on 'No, I won't leave you', then slower and warmer; a breath before 'Your God'
ru_03.d: 画面：你紧紧握住婆婆的手，怎么也不肯放开。
ru_03.d_en: Picture: you hold your mother-in-law's hands tight and won't let go.

phrases.text: No, I won't leave you!
Where you go, I will go.
Where you stay, I will stay.
Your God...
will be my God.

ru_04.m: 声音里有走路的节奏（走呀走）；说到“终于”时亮起来；说到收大麦时带一点微笑
ru_04.m_en: a walking rhythm in the voice ('walked and walked'); brighter on 'at last'; a small smile on the harvest
ru_04.d: 画面：你用手指在图画书上沿着长长的路走到伯利恒。
ru_04.d_en: Picture: your finger walks along the long road in the picture book to Bethlehem.

phrases.text: They walked and walked,
a long, long way,
and at last they came to Bethlehem.
It was barley harvest time.

ru_05.m: 先长长地叹一口气；轻声、空落落的；后半句前停一下
ru_05.m_en: a long sigh first; quiet, empty; slow, with a break before the second half
ru_05.d: 画面：你站在空空的老家门口，什么都没有了。
ru_05.d_en: Picture: you stand at the door of an empty old home.

ru_06.m: 先温柔地安慰，然后变得明亮、带着微笑、有干劲；结尾稍快
ru_06.m_en: gentle first, then bright and eager with a little smile; a bit quicker at the end
ru_06.d: 画面：你蹲下来拉着难过的奶奶的手，想让她笑一笑。
ru_06.d_en: Picture: you crouch by a sad grandmother and try to make her smile.

phrases.text: Don't be sad, Mother.
I'll go and pick up grain in the fields,
then we'll have food to eat!

ru_07.m: 平静地讲解，像家长指着图画给孩子看；“一根一根”一个字一个字地说清楚
ru_07.m_en: calm, explaining, like a parent pointing at a picture; slow on 'one stalk at a time'
ru_07.d: 画面：你指着书上田边的小麦穗给孩子看。
ru_07.d_en: Picture: you point to the stalks at the edge of the field in the book.

phrases.text: In Israel, the harvesters left some grain behind for poor people to pick up.
So Ruth knelt at the edge of the field and picked it up,
one stalk at a time.

ru_08.d: 画面：你在介绍一位你很佩服的好人。
ru_08.d_en: Picture: you introduce a good man you admire.

phrases.text: The field belonged to a man named Boaz.
He was rich, and he was very kind.

ru_09.m: 爽朗友好，声音能传到田的另一头；满脸笑容
ru_09.m_en: hearty and friendly, loud enough to carry across a field; a big smile
ru_09.d: 画面：你一大早走进自家的田，跟干活的人大声打招呼。
ru_09.d_en: Picture: early morning, you walk into your field and call out to your workers.

phrases.text: Good morning, everyone!
The Lord be with you!

ru_10.m: 三四个干活的人从田那头一起回答，高高兴兴，有先有后，不整齐
ru_10.m_en: three or four workers answering together from across the field, cheerful, a little ragged
ru_10.d: 画面：你们在田里弯着腰干活，抬头大声回应主人。
ru_10.d_en: Picture: you are bent over in the field and look up to call back to the owner.

ru_11.m: 走着走着停下来，好奇又温和；先“咦”一声在想
ru_11.m_en: he stops mid-step, curious and gentle; a thinking 'Hm' first
ru_11.d: 画面：你忽然看见一个没见过的人，歪着头想。
ru_11.d_en: Picture: you suddenly spot someone new and tilt your head.

phrases.text: Hmm?
Who's that young woman over there?

en.say: Hmm? Who's that young woman over there?

ru_12.m: 慈祥，像父亲一样，不慌不忙；说“那边”时像在指着水罐
ru_12.m_en: kind, fatherly, unhurried; as if pointing at the jars on 'water jars'
ru_12.d: 画面：你对一个新来的孩子说：在这儿别怕，渴了就去喝水。
ru_12.d_en: Picture: you tell a newcomer not to worry and to drink when thirsty.

phrases.text: Stay here and gather in my field.
Don't go anywhere else.
And when you're thirsty,
go and drink from the water jars.

ru_13.m: 害羞、惊讶，几乎是小声说；问句轻轻往上扬
ru_13.m_en: shy, amazed, almost a whisper; the question rises gently
ru_13.d: 画面：一个大人对你特别好，你不敢相信，小声问为什么。
ru_13.d_en: Picture: a grown-up is very kind to you; you quietly ask why.

phrases.text: I'm a stranger here...
why are you so kind to me?

ru_14.m: 温暖、感动，声音里带着笑；祝福那句更郑重
ru_14.m_en: warm and moved, a smile in the voice; the blessing a little slower
ru_14.d: 画面：你听说一个人很孝顺，你真心为她高兴。
ru_14.d_en: Picture: you've heard how good someone has been, and you are glad for her.

phrases.text: I've heard all about how good you've been to Naomi.
May God reward you for it!

ru_15.m: 压低声音的悄悄话，调皮、咧嘴笑；先神神秘秘，说到“留给她捡”时俏皮地扬起来，最后嘿嘿笑两声
ru_15.m_en: stage whisper, playful, grinning; slow and secretive, then a cheeky lift on 'for her to pick up', then a little chuckle
ru_15.d: 画面：你偷偷给好朋友多放了一块糖，还不想让她知道。
ru_15.d_en: Picture: you secretly slip an extra sweet to a friend.

phrases.text: Listen...
when you cut the barley,
drop a little extra on purpose...
for her to pick up!
Heh heh.

ru_16.m: 越说越高兴；“满满一大捆”说得又大又圆
ru_16.m_en: building delight; big and round on 'great big bundle'
ru_16.d: 画面：你把一大捆东西抱给孩子看：哇，这么多！
ru_16.d_en: Picture: you show the child a huge armful: look how much!

phrases.text: By evening,
Ruth had gathered a great big bundle of barley!

ru_17.m: 真的很惊讶，这是她第一次听起来开心；说“这么多呀”时笑出来一点
ru_17.m_en: genuinely amazed, the first time she sounds happy; a little laugh on 'So much!'
ru_17.d: 画面：孩子抱回一大堆东西，你惊喜得睁大眼睛。
ru_17.d_en: Picture: a child brings home a huge armful and your eyes go wide.

ru_18.d: 画面：你一路跑回家，急着告诉妈妈好消息。
ru_18.d_en: Picture: you ran all the way home to tell good news.

phrases.text: A man called Boaz.
He was so kind to me!

ru_19.m: 惊讶变成喜悦和感激的泪；“他没有忘记我们”之前声音一哽
ru_19.m_en: surprise turning into joy and thankful tears; a catch in the voice before 'He hasn't forgotten us'
ru_19.d: 画面：你忽然明白，上帝一直在照顾你，眼泪涌上来。
ru_19.d_en: Picture: you suddenly see you were cared for all along, and tears come.

ru_20.m: 夜里，压低声音，有点秘密，带着盼望
ru_20.m_en: hushed, night-time, a little secret and hopeful
ru_20.d: 画面：夜里，你小声给孩子讲一个秘密的计划。
ru_20.d_en: Picture: at night you whisper a secret plan to the child.

phrases.text: Naomi thought,
'If only Boaz would take care of Ruth!'
So one night, Ruth went to find Boaz at the threshing floor.

ru_21.m: 轻轻的，紧张又勇敢；“求您”之前轻轻吸一口气
ru_21.m_en: soft, nervous, brave; a small breath before 'will you please'
ru_21.d: 画面：你鼓起勇气，向一位大人请求帮忙。
ru_21.d_en: Picture: you gather your courage to ask a grown-up for help.

phrases.text: Boaz, you're part of our family...
will you please take care of us?

ru_22.m: 先非常温柔，然后说承诺时坚定、肯定；带着笑
ru_22.m_en: very gentle, then firm and sure on the promise; a smile
ru_22.d: 画面：一个孩子害怕地来求你，你蹲下来让她放心。
ru_22.d_en: Picture: a frightened child asks you for help and you reassure her.

phrases.text: Don't be afraid, my daughter.
Everyone knows you're a good woman.
I will take care of you,
I promise!

ru_23.m: 明亮、开心，听得见的笑容
ru_23.m_en: bright and happy, a smile you can hear
ru_23.d: 画面：你在讲一场热热闹闹的婚礼。
ru_23.d_en: Picture: you describe a joyful wedding.

phrases.text: And so Boaz married Ruth.
The whole town came to celebrate with them!

ru_24.m: 轻柔温馨，像在看摇篮里的宝宝；名字说得清楚、温柔
ru_24.m_en: soft and tender, like looking into a cradle; slow on the name
ru_24.d: 画面：你俯身看着摇篮里睡着的小宝宝。
ru_24.d_en: Picture: you lean over a sleeping baby in a cradle.

phrases.text: Before long, they had a baby boy.
They named him...
Obed.

ru_25.m: 喜极而泣，半笑半哭；像摇着宝宝的节奏；最后几个字充满惊奇
ru_25.m_en: happy tears, half laughing; a rocking rhythm; the last words full of wonder
ru_25.d: 画面：你抱着刚出生的小孙子，轻轻摇着。
ru_25.d_en: Picture: you rock your newborn grandson in your arms.

ru_26.m: 调皮，凑近孩子分享秘密；说到“大卫”时开心地揭晓
ru_26.m_en: playful, leaning in to share a secret; a big happy reveal on 'David'
ru_26.d: 画面：你凑到孩子耳边：告诉你一个秘密哦！
ru_26.d_en: Picture: you lean to the child's ear: want to know a secret?

phrases.text: And guess what?
When Obed grew up, he had a grandson named...
David.
Yes, the David who beat Goliath!

ru_27.m: 温暖的结尾，直接对孩子说；最后一句带着笑
ru_27.m_en: warm moral, speaking right to the child; a smile on the last sentence
ru_27.d: 画面：讲完故事，你摸摸孩子的头。
ru_27.d_en: Picture: the story is over and you stroke the child's hair.

phrases.text: Ruth never left Naomi,
and God took care of them all along.
You can love your family like that too!
